HPC & AI Performance Engineer   
 
 
 
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office. 
 
 Who We Are: 














 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.














 
 
 Job Description: 
    
 HPE is seeking a High-Performance Computing (HPC) Benchmarking Performance Engineer to work with both standard and scientific application benchmarks on HPE’s supercomputing platforms. Familiarity with HPC is advantageous, particularly in areas such as processor performance, network technologies, software expertise, and application performance and scalability. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong technical skills in HPC scientific application software, performance analysis, and a solid understanding of HPC hardware and architecture, applying this knowledge to benchmarking activities for HPE supercomputers deployed globally.
 
 HPE operates in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. We are looking for driven engineers who consistently deliver the high-quality results for HPE’s HPC & AI customers.
 
 Responsibilities:
 Successfully complete long and short-term benchmark projects involving some of the largest HPC systems in the world that utilize the newest HPC technologies.
 Understand HPC architectural components and features, as well as performance estimation methodologies used to provide required information and performance assessments for benchmarks on future HPE and competitive systems.
 Complete and provide technical analysis of HPC I/O, standard and scientific application performance-based benchmark tests.
 Identify solutions, define action plans, and help coordinate and deliver optimal benchmark enhancements and solutions.
 Proactively develop and maintain advanced knowledge of HPE and competitor HPC products by participating in targeted training sessions, and collaborating with internal and external HPC experts. Apply specialised HPC performance optimisation techniques including parallel processing, efficient memory management, and comprehensive code profiling to ensure delivery of robust benchmark performance results on HPE’s HPC and AI systems.
 
 Qualifications:
 Experience with storage benchmarks, profiling tools and/or software for HPC systems. Coursework and internship experience is considered relevant
 Knowledge of HPC system components that include processor technologies, accelerator technologies, memory technologies, & software technologies – and the ability to understand their impacts on various HPC benchmarks.
 Understanding of parallel programming techniques and algorithms.
 Ability to take on some of the most challenging HPC projects to advance the capabilities of HPC which will benefit HPE customers and the world.
 A demonstrated ability to assess and optimize aspects of computational application benchmark performance on HPC Linux based system
 Expertise with software utilized by the HPC community that includes Compilers (C++, C, Fortran), OpenMP, MPI & MPI-IO, Python and other Linux based scripting languages 
 Expertise in GPU programming (CUDA and HIP)
 Ability to use Performance profiling tools and debugging tools on Linux based systems.
 Familiarity with analyzing and assessing benchmark and application performance for HPC systems.
 Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery of English required.
 Masters degree [PhD preferred] in a technical field (Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Environmental, etc.).
 
 
 Accessibility 

 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here .

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability. 
 
 
 What We Can Offer You: 







 Health & Wellbeing 
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
 
 Personal & Professional Development 
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
 
 Unconditional Inclusion 
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
 
 
 Let's Stay Connected:
